item.description:
The United States is one of the most authoritarian systems of the world has ever seen - and before you criticise me for making that stupidly obvious statement, I want you to consider why we value democracy, it’s not just because people *can* vote, but it’s because that vote changes the policies that affect them. But the vast majority of the world does not experience America as the consequence of their own votes, but they experienced America as Palestinians experience Israel. And the fact that certain people voted doesn’t change the boot on their neck.
